changelog:
- Initial release of hutian-opc-business-plan.
- Provides a professional business plan generation tool using an interactive Q&A, multi-turn dialogue system.
- Supports structured information collection to build comprehensive, data-driven, and logically sound PPT business plans.
- Covers five essential modules: Market Analysis, Feasibility, Financials, Team/Resource Planning, and Risk Management.
- Includes detailed question templates and guidance for each module.
- Delivers a standardized PPT (15-20 pages) suitable for investment pitch, strategy development, and other key business scenarios.
